title: A point that asks for help is on the 15-month communication list
summary: CDC says most children point in order to request an object or assistance by about 15 months.
body: The communication section at 15 months includes pointing to ask for something or to get help. The finger is doing the job of a request: bring that, or come help. CDC's most on milestone pages means 75 percent or more, so this is not a claim about every toddler. The 1-year activity tips mention that babies point when they want something, yet that birthday's milestone list does not include this request. The sheets are not a diagnosis. The month is the one printed in the United States.
